theme: 教材片語・進階 650–750 第 7 群

items.colloc: lock the filing cabinet 上鎖檔案櫃 | organize a filing cabinet 整理檔案櫃
items.distinct: file folder 資料夾 | filing system 歸檔系統
ex: Please put the contract in the filing cabinet.
請將合約放進檔案櫃中。
The filing cabinet is full of old invoices.
那個檔案櫃裝滿了舊發票。
I cannot find the document in the filing cabinet.
我在檔案櫃裡找不到那份文件。

items.colloc: the first step toward 邁向…的第一步 | take the first step 採取第一步
items.distinct: initial stage 初級階段 | priority 優先事項
ex: Setting a budget is the first step of the project.
制定預算是該專案的第一步。
This meeting is the first step toward a new partnership.
這次會議是邁向新合作關係的第一步。
Taking initiative is the first step to success.
主動積極是邁向成功的第一步。

items.colloc: get off at the station 在車站下車 | get off work 下班
items.distinct: get on 上車 | take off 起飛
ex: You should get off at the next stop.
你應該在下一站下車。
Most employees get off work at six o'clock.
大多數員工在六點鐘下班。
We need to get off early to avoid the traffic.
為了避開交通我們需要早點出發。

items.colloc: a small get-together 小型聚會 | get together with colleagues 與同事聚會
items.distinct: gather 收集 | assemble 裝配
ex: The team will get together to celebrate the project.
團隊將聚在一起慶祝專案完成。
Let us get together to discuss the marketing plan.
我們聚在一起討論行銷計畫吧。
We usually get together for lunch every Friday.
我們通常每週五聚在一起吃午餐。

items.colloc: three days in a row 連續三天 | sit in a row 排成一排坐
items.distinct: consecutively 連續地 | in sequence 依順序
ex: She has been late for three days in a row.
她已經連續三天遲到了。
The workers are standing in a row by the desk.
工人們正排成一排站在桌子旁。
We met five clients in a row this morning.
今天早上我們連續見了五位客戶。

items.colloc: be in charge of the department 負責該部門 | put someone in charge of 指派某人負責
items.distinct: responsible for 對…負責 | oversee 監督
ex: Who is currently in charge of this account?
目前是誰負責這個帳戶？
She was put in charge of the new project.
她被指派負責這個新專案。
The manager is in charge of training new staff.
經理負責培訓新員工。

items.colloc: use digital files instead of paper 使用數位檔而非紙本 | instead of doing something 而不做某事
items.distinct: in place of 取代 | rather than 而不是
ex: Let us use video calls instead of traveling.
我們用視訊通話代替出差吧。
He chose the cheaper option instead of the premium one.
他選擇了較便宜的選項而不是高級版。
Please send an email instead of calling me.
請傳電子郵件給我，而不是打電話。

items.colloc: official job title 正式職稱 | update one's job title 更新職稱
items.distinct: job description 工作說明 | position 職位
ex: His job title on the business card is Director.
他名片上的職稱是總監。
Please list your current job title on the form.
請在表格上列出你目前的職稱。
The job title does not reflect my actual duties.
這個職稱無法反映我的實際工作內容。

items.colloc: a prestigious law firm 知名的法律事務所 | work at a law firm 在法律事務所工作
items.distinct: legal department 法務部門 | court 法院
ex: He works as a paralegal at a law firm.
他在一家法律事務所擔任律師助理。
Our company hired a law firm for legal advice.
我們公司聘請了一家法律事務所進行諮詢。
The law firm is located in the city center.
那家法律事務所位於市中心。

items.pos: v. 傾斜；倚靠 | adj. 精簡的
items.colloc: lean against the wall 靠在牆上 | lean operation 精實營運
items.distinct: bend 彎曲 | tilt 傾斜
ex: Do not lean against the glass door, please.
請不要靠在玻璃門上。
The company adopted a lean strategy to cut costs.
公司採取了精簡策略來削減成本。
She leaned forward to hear the speaker better.
她向前傾以便聽清楚演講者的聲音。

items.colloc: play cards during a break 休息時玩牌 | enjoy playing cards 喜歡玩牌
items.distinct: board game 桌遊 | card game 紙牌遊戲
ex: The staff played cards during their lunch break.
員工在午休時間玩牌。
We do not usually play cards in the office.
我們通常不在辦公室裡玩牌。
Some people play cards to relax after work.
有些人下班後會透過玩牌來放鬆。

items.colloc: point at the screen 指向螢幕 | point at the map 指向地圖
items.distinct: point out 指出 | aim at 瞄準
ex: The presenter pointed at the graph on the wall.
報告者指向牆上的圖表。
Please do not point at people during the meeting.
開會時請不要用手指著別人。
He pointed at the document to show the error.
他指著文件以顯示錯誤之處。

items.colloc: prepare a meal for guests 為客人準備餐點 | help prepare a meal 協助準備餐點
items.distinct: cook 烹飪 | serve a meal 上菜
ex: The chef is preparing a meal for the CEO.
廚師正在為執行長準備餐點。
It takes time to prepare a meal for many people.
為多人準備餐點需要很多時間。
Can you help prepare a meal for the reception?
你可以幫忙準備接待會的餐點嗎？

items.colloc: print out the report 列印報告 | print out hard copies 列印紙本
items.distinct: print press 印刷機 | make a copy 影印
ex: Please print out the agenda before the meeting starts.
會議開始前請列印出議程。
I need to print out these files for my records.
我需要將這些檔案列印出來存檔。
Do not print out emails unless it is necessary.
除非必要，否則不要列印電子郵件。

items.colloc: visit the public library 造訪公共圖書館 | local public library 當地公共圖書館
items.distinct: university library 大學圖書館 | bookstore 書店
ex: The public library is closed on national holidays.
公共圖書館在國定假日休息。
She went to the public library to research data.
她去公共圖書館查詢資料。
The city is building a new public library nearby.
該市正在附近興建一座新的公共圖書館。

items.colloc: send out invitations 發出邀請函 | send out newsletters 發送電子報
items.distinct: mail 寄送 | distribute 分發
ex: We will send out the survey results tomorrow.
我們明天會發送調查結果。
Did you send out the emails to all staff?
你發送電子郵件給全體員工了嗎？
The company sends out updates every month.
公司每個月都會發送最新資訊。

items.colloc: look up to a mentor 敬重導師 | look up to a leader 景仰領袖
items.distinct: look down on 輕視 | look for 尋找
ex: Many junior staff look up to our creative director.
許多基層員工都非常敬重我們的創意總監。
She is a manager whom all employees truly look up to.
她是所有員工都真心敬佩的一位經理。
Young professionals look up to successful business leaders today.
現代年輕專業人士很敬仰成功的商業領袖。

items.colloc: speed up the process 加速流程 | speed up production 加速生產
items.distinct: accelerate 加速 | expedite 迅速處理
ex: We need to speed up the shipping process.
我們需要加速出貨流程。
The new software should speed up our daily tasks.
新軟體應該能加速我們的日常工作。
Can we do something to speed up the project?
我們有什麼方法可以加速這個專案嗎？

items.pos: phr. 從事；致力於；努力改善
items.colloc: work on a project 致力於專案 | work on weaknesses 改善弱點
items.distinct: work with 與…合作 | work for 為…工作
ex: Our team is working on a new marketing strategy.
我們的團隊正致力於一項新的行銷策略。
He is currently working on his communication skills.
他目前正努力改善他的溝通技巧。
I have been working on this report all morning.
我整個早上都在處理這份報告。

items.colloc: in the early morning 在清晨 | early morning flight 清晨的班機
items.distinct: late night 深夜 | morning 早上
ex: We have an early morning meeting at eight.
我們八點有個清晨的會議。
The early morning air is very refreshing.
清晨的空氣非常清新。
Most of the staff arrive in the early morning.
大多數員工在清晨抵達辦公室。
